title: This Frozen Moon May Hide More Water Than All of Earth's Oceans
description:
Beneath the ice of Jupiter's moon Europa, scientists think a salty ocean may hold about twice as much water as all of Earth's oceans. Tidal heating from Jupiter, carbon dioxide spotted by the Webb telescope and oxygen measured by Juno make it one of the best places to search for conditions suitable for life. No life has been found there, or anywhere beyond Earth. NASA's Europa Clipper arrives in 2030 to study whether this ocean could be habitable.
